No secondary runtime receipt content/fragment validation
No source-authority or behavior accuracy percentage
scope.stage_rule: All historical_pair/native flags are zero in this stage2 view. Parent explicitly plans a later OSS historical/native4/4 supplement; zero is not classified as a current error, nor is that future supplement verified here.

required_field_checks.finding_null_exception: STD-F01–STD-F05 have finding=null because original bodies were not read; failure reason and count0 are present. This is appropriate, not missing substantive evidence to fabricate.
required_field_checks.source_utc_formats: ISO8601 plus eight OSS PR/issue records in explicit YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC; both were treated as valid UTC.

reference_checks.artifact_fragment_validation: not performed; base existence does not verify record content
reference_checks.P1P2_presence_is_not_success: Applicability, static versus executed status and acceptance remain separate.

findings.evidence: All six C01/C02/C03 P1/P2 rows contain the prose fallback see linked current-runtime/HTTP receipt for the observation timestamp, not an actual UTC timestamp. Assembler line136 deliberately inserts that fallback.
findings.impact: The integrated observation cannot directly state when it was checked, and readers must locate an unspecified secondary receipt. Source-row UTCs do not automatically equal observation execution times.
findings.minimal_fix: Resolve each observation to its actual read/run/HTTP receipt and copy the recorded UTC, or use explicit null plus missing_reason and a fully-qualified receipt location. Do not invent a time.

findings.evidence: Root run references have seven occurrences/six unique IDs but no artifact filename. Three OSS references name current-native.jsonl without streams/oss prefix. Existing observation back-links make them potentially recoverable, so this is not proof that execution evidence is absent.
findings.impact: A consumer of the integrated root-level ledger cannot resolve these run records without implicit stream knowledge or searching. Actual body of those secondary receipts was outside this audit’s four-file input.
findings.minimal_fix: Normalize every local run locator to an owned-path-relative file plus stable record ID, e.g. streams/oss/current-native.jsonl#record-id. Resolve root run IDs to their actual receipt file, not an assumed filename. Keep original stream references too.

findings.evidence: Both representative counted rows retain a mutable master/stable URL as fixed_location. They include UTC, section, body SHA256 and edition context, so the substantive source fields are not absent; the locator itself is not immutable.
findings.impact: A future reader may retrieve changed bytes at the same supposed fixed location. A hash detects change but cannot by itself recover the old bytes.
findings.minimal_fix: Use the already-known pinned extra-drivers commit for matching README content after hash/section verification and a versioned Pillow13.0 documentation or source commit matching the observed page. Preserve live opened URL independently; do not relabel a different revision as the opened text.

findings.evidence: current_supplement_executed is true on19 rows:11 GET-policy observations plus8 non-HTTP-only/current behavior observation rows. The evidence_kind fields distinguish them.
findings.impact: Summing this boolean as a software/native execution numerator would count HTTP GETs as functional tests. This audit found no current claim that19 native tests occurred.
findings.minimal_fix: Report HTTP observations and current behavior/native supplements separately, or add an explicit execution domain. Keep historical pairs in a separate stage/supplement field.

prospective_normalizer_risks.issue: Missing actually_opened_url is silently filled from original_url; missing fixed_location receives original URL/edition/section/hash. This can make a demanded field appear complete without independently recorded acquisition/pinning.
prospective_normalizer_risks.recommendation: Retain field_origin values and null/missing flags; validate actual opened URL against acquisition receipts rather than inferring equality. This audit did not inspect upstream stream schemas to count uses of this fallback.

prospective_normalizer_risks.issue: Independent works are summed flags rather than deduplicated work IDs, and natural8/control3/complete-controls2 plus HTTP11 and behavior=len-11 are constants.
prospective_normalizer_risks.recommendation: Assert one counted representative per work_id and derive event/observation counts from typed rows. Current32 counted flags equal32 unique work IDs and current frame is4GIS+4OSS+3controls, so no present overcount is identified.

prospective_normalizer_risks.issue: OSS U calculation treats all final2xx as keep_record without evaluating301/308 chain. Control calculation uses any301/308 and does not reject an otherwise mixed302/307 chain. This does not implement the sealed rule generally.
prospective_normalizer_risks.recommendation: Apply one shared chain classifier to every domain. Current11 observed chains/actions have no demonstrated mismatch: OSS has no redirects; the control repair is one301→200.

prospective_normalizer_risks.issue: Execution can be inferred from a nonempty run_ids list or current in observation_kind. Unknown source references are silently treated as artifact paths.
prospective_normalizer_risks.recommendation: Require typed evidence/run records and fail or explicitly preserve unresolved source IDs. Current referenced source IDs all resolve and all path-bearing artifact base files exist; fragments and run contents were not checked.

prospective_normalizer_risks.issue: STD-S05 is directly_read=true and counted with http_status403. Its limitation explicitly records successful web body reading versus failed shell retrieval, so treating403 alone as unread would be wrong.
prospective_normalizer_risks.recommendation: Keep web/shell channel-specific receipts and accession results as separate structured fields, not only in limitation prose. Do not remove this row merely because the independent shell probe was403.

conclusions: No present inflation found from counting HTTP/metadata-only, machine-screened or failed-body rows as independently read works: all32 counted representatives are direct-body records and have unique work IDs.
154 is the source/acquisition row count;109 is the recorded direct-body read count;32 is the conservative counted-work number. These denominators are not interchangeable.
Natural allocation remains GIS4+OSS4=8; controls remain3 with C02 original archive partial. No control has been moved into the natural denominator.
Root observation UTC and run locator gaps should be repaired before calling the integrated ledger self-contained.
Later historical runtime integration needs a separate stage-aware update and evidence linkage; current zero flags alone are not an audit failure.
